services.name: exhibition page
services.desc: A working studio and gallery developing exceptional artists through fellowships, subsidized and free workshops, and commissions. The initial exhibition of the first works from the Seattle Prize Fellowship cohort, hung together for the first time. These are the paintings they set out to make when the rest of their lives got out of the way: ambitious, slow, and built to last. Showing alongside the Beautiful Things exhibition. Learn more about the fellowship at seattleprize.org. The exhibition is free and open all summer, June 26 to September 6, 2026, at the Occidental Fine Arts Center in Pioneer Square, Seattle.
